priorityList: Maintain Arcane Intellect at all times.
Cast Mirror Image during pre-combat or when cooldowns are unavailable.
Cast Evocation if mana is below 10% and major cooldowns (Arcane Surge/Touch of the Magi) are not active.
Cast Arcane Surge on cooldown to initiate your primary burn phase.
Cast Touch of the Magi while Arcane Surge is active, or if Arcane Surge has more than 30 seconds remaining on cooldown.
Use offensive Trinkets, Potions, and Racial abilities (like Berserking or Blood Fury) during Arcane Surge and Touch of the Magi windows.
Cast Arcane Barrage as your top priority while Arcane Soul is active.
Cast Arcane Barrage at 4 Arcane Charges if Touch of the Magi is about to expire.
Cast Arcane Barrage if Arcane Salvo has reached its maximum of 25 stacks.
Cast Arcane Missiles whenever Clearcasting is active, prioritizing usage during Arcane Surge and Touch of the Magi.
Cast Arcane Orb if you have fewer than 2 Arcane Charges to quickly build resources.
Cast Arcane Pulse if you have fewer than 3 Arcane Charges and your mana is above 50%.
Cast Arcane Blast as your primary filler to generate Arcane Charges.
Cast Arcane Barrage at 4 Arcane Charges to reset charges and generate Spellfire Spheres if not currently in a burn phase.
